coverage.definition: Named commercial LC, UHPLC, LC-MS, LC-MS/MS, detector, automation, and workflow-software systems from the five competitors tracked by this dashboard. Product families are represented once; individual modules, accessories, software point releases, and geography-only variants are excluded.
coverage.datePolicy: Use the manufacturer's exact launch date when available. Otherwise use the manufacturer-stated introduction year or the earliest dated official manufacturer record and label it as an introduction year.
coverage.limitations: Older manufacturer archives are incomplete. This is a sourced major-system catalog, not a claim that every historical module or SKU ever sold is represented.
